input.quote: 14.3 Certain Additional Consequences of Termination. In the event of any termination of this Agreement pursuant to Section 14.2, then, if SFJ has not caused a Program Transfer to occur pursuant to Section 3.20:
input.rationale: The only exit mechanics are Section 14.3 (assignment of the Trial Data Package/Research Results, transfer of Product Filings, wind-down or continued conduct of Clinical Trials) and Section 10.3 (return/destruction of Confidential Information). These fail the fallback on material terms: (i) Section 14.3 is triggered only by termination under Section 14.2 and only if SFJ has not caused a Program Transfer, so it does not apply on expiration of the Agreement; (ii) the transition period in 14.3.4(ii)(y) is redacted ([***]), so no minimum 90-day assistance period is established; and (iii) the delivery obligation in 14.3.3 runs from assignment of the Product Filings for a redacted period ([***]), not within a fixed 30 days of expiry or termination. We therefore insert a short free-standing Section 14.5 carrying only the three fallback elements, leaving Sections 14.3 and 10.3 untouched.

proposal.summary: Insert a free-standing transition assistance and data delivery clause at the end of Article 14
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.3 only operates on termination under Section 14.2 (and not if a Program Transfer occurs), and its transition and data delivery periods are left open, so we have added a short Section 14.5 giving us at least 90 days of transition assistance and delivery of our trial data within 30 days of expiry or termination. This is our fallback exit position; we are happy to discuss the 6-month/then-current-rates formulation instead.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Data Delivery. Upon expiration or any termination of this Agreement, SFJ shall (a) at PB's request, provide PB with reasonable transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days following such expiration or termination, and (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, deliver to PB all data generated in connection with the Clinical Trials, including the Trial Data Package and the Research Results included therein.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
